title: Ask works on a Mac that has nothing else installed
goal: A person who has installed only Photonz can press Ask and have it work. Either it answers straight away, or Ask offers one button that gets Photonz ready inside the app: it says how big the download is before it starts, shows progress, and can be stopped. Today Ask says it needs a separate program and sends the person to another website to install it, so on most Macs Ask does nothing.
notes: Focus success gap: agent-ask success item 2 says which models answer 'works out of the box'. Today Ask needs Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434 (Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskLocalModel.swift:10) with qwen3:30b, 18.6 GB (AskPlanning.swift:503, AskModels). With no Ollama it says 'Ask needs Ollama. See Settings.' (AskLocalModel.swift:30-31) and Settings links Ollama's website. The 2026-10-19 Ask audit's last rough line: that path was never walked, since this Mac has Ollama. Apple's FoundationModels was rejected for a 4,096 token window against about 5,800 tokens of tools plus document (docs/design/ask.md, model table): a tool list cut per request (looking tools plus the four or five doing tools the request needs) may fit, measure it. An in-app runtime (for example MLX Swift with a downloaded model) avoids a second program. Not reproduced as a click on a fresh Mac by the manager (this Mac has Ollama); the code path above is what a Mac without it reaches. Do not uninstall or stop the person's Ollama; use a seam on the probe. Runs after the eval task if it is done, otherwise score by the three walks and the eval's rubric by hand.
acceptance: Reproduce first: with the local model runner Ask uses today made unreachable to the probe (stopped, or its port pointed elsewhere through a test seam), press Ask on a screenshot and record what the person sees. That is the before picture
After the change, from that state a person reaches a working answer in at most two clicks from Ask's own message, never leaving Photonz for the Terminal or another website
Anything downloaded says its size and where it goes before it starts, shows progress, can be stopped, and lives in Settings > Ask; while it gets ready Ask says so in one short plain sentence

Pick the way in, measure it and log why (do not stop to ask): a model run inside Photonz itself, the Mac's own on-device model with a smaller tool list chosen per request, or another way. The pick must make the three try requests (screenshot measurements, the Case 1 title page before a clip, a pricing section on brand) come out at least as well as today's default model, scored with the eval from a-scored-test-set-for-what-ask-and-the-photonz-s, with the time to a result for each in the audit
A Mac that already has today's runner and model keeps working exactly as now
After setup, with the app's network blocked (a block on the probe, never the person's Wi-Fi while the loop runs), the three try requests still run
Shipped behind next-ask at Next defaults; try path: Settings > Ask from nothing set up, then Ask on a screenshot. Copy is short and plain, no em dashes, no vendor names

Audit written under queue/audits/ with the before and after pictures and the timings. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

The picture model Ask paints its drawings with (Scripts/picture-model, Z-Image Turbo about 11 GB, on at Next defaults since 2026-10-22) is part of the same setup: installed from Settings > Ask with its size shown, started and stopped by Photonz when Ask needs it, never by a person running serve.sh. Without it Ask falls back to its old drawing route, which scored 35.9 against painting's held-out total

log.note: intake 2026-10-20: the default model is being re-picked by the scores in ask-runs-on-the-best-model-this-mac-can-hold-pic (seq 8.1, runs first). What gets downloaded out of the box should be that winner, or the best that fits the Mac, not qwen3:30b.

2026-10-21: today's default model is now qwen3.6:27b (18 GB download, ~30 GB held), and Settings offers the best model the Mac can hold by memory (AskModels.recommended); compare against that, not qwen3:30b.

From try-drawing-with-a-local-picture-model-then-turn (2026-10-22): Ask now paints drawings with a local picture model when 127.0.0.1:8793 answers (Scripts/picture-model/serve.sh, a Python+MLX server). Today nothing starts it, so a person only gets painting if someone runs serve.sh. Added an acceptance item: the picture model joins this task's in-app setup and is started by Photonz. The runner (mflux, MIT) is Python; a native Swift MLX port or an app-managed bundled environment are the two ways in.
